title: login detection reads the wrong account on JIS-NUC: supervisor wait said this app is login A while the app session is B (usage reset 2026-11-08 matches B). mts_signal.login() reads the home .claude.json; a stale or other sign-in there overrides the typed letter, so budget and wait signals can post under the wrong login. Workaround: env MTS_LOGIN=B.
